visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a product package featuring a cartoon gorilla with the text 'GORILLA HIGH POWER'. A woman with long brown hair and a beige vest holds the product, smiling at the camera in a brightly lit indoor room with wood paneling. (2) The scene shifts to a bedroom with an ornate white headboard. A woman wearing a large white furry hat and a cream jacket sits on the bed. A purple fabric massager is wrapped around her lower leg. A hand presses a button on the device, causing it to tighten. She reacts with wide eyes and an open mouth in shock. (3) A second woman with silver-blonde hair sits on the bed, wearing a striped sweater. The purple massager is applied to her leg. She looks calm and smiles, seemingly enjoying the sensation while gesturing with her hands. (4) A third woman in a beige sweater sits on the bed. The massager is tightened around her calf. She smiles and gives two thumbs up to the camera. (5) A man wearing a black baseball cap and a grey t-shirt reclines on the bed. The purple massager is wrapped around his leg. He winces slightly and clenches his fist as the device operates. (6) A man with glasses in a yellow sweatshirt is shown in a living room area, then a close-up shows him wincing and closing his eyes as if in mild pain while the device is applied to him off-screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female narration begins over a bright, synth-driven pop BGM with a steady electronic beat. A mechanical click is heard as the massager starts. (2) A transition whoosh triggers a new phase. A female voice screams 'Ah!' in high-pitched surprise, followed by laughter and light-hearted chatter. The BGM remains constant and upbeat. (3) A ding sound marks a change in speaker. A second female voice speaks in a calm, conversational tone, praising the comfort of the device. Background laughter from others is audible. (4) A loud cartoon-style 'pop' sound effect occurs. A third female voice expresses excitement, speaking at a fast rate with high pitch. (5) A muffled motor hum from the leg massager becomes more prominent. A male voice winces with a sharp intake of breath, followed by teasing comments from the female host. (6) A final stinger SFX ends the video as a male voice exclaims 'Ouch!' in a comedic, exaggerated manner while the music swells slightly before a hard cut.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate and review a high-power Japanese leg massager by showing the authentic and humorous reactions of different friends with varying pain thresholds, ultimately portraying the product as effective and worth purchasing.
